title: Data Processing Module
summary: This module handles the preprocessing of various data types (images, text, audio) to prepare them for consumption by machine learning models. It includes specialized processors and tokenizers for different modalities and tasks.

nodes.label: Raw Data Input
nodes.title: Unprocessed Input Data
nodes.description: Represents the initial, unprocessed data provided by users or datasets, encompassing various modalities like images, text, and audio.

nodes.label: Image Processing
nodes.title: Image Preprocessing Sub-module
nodes.description: Handles the transformation and preparation of raw image data, applying operations like resizing, normalization, and format conversion for computer vision models.

nodes.label: Text & Audio Processing
nodes.title: Text and Audio Preprocessing Sub-module
nodes.description: Manages the tokenization of text, multimodal data preparation, and normalization of numerical text, crucial for language and speech models.

nodes.label: Model-Ready Features
nodes.title: Prepared Model Inputs
nodes.description: The output of the data processing pipeline, consisting of transformed and encoded features formatted for direct consumption by machine learning models.

nodes.label: Model Architectures
nodes.title: Model Architectures Module
nodes.description: The collection of various machine learning model definitions that consume the prepared data for inference or training.

groups.label: Input Sources
groups.title: Raw Data Input Sources
groups.description: Represents the initial, untransformed data streams entering the processing pipeline.

groups.label: Processing Core
groups.title: Core Data Processing Logic
groups.description: Contains the specialized sub-modules responsible for transforming raw data into model-compatible formats across different modalities.

groups.label: Model Integration
groups.title: Model Input & Consumption
groups.description: Represents the final, prepared data ready for machine learning models and the models themselves that utilize this data.
